iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: May 10 evening scan: Al Arabiya reports Iran softened its position and agreed to include the nuclear file in US talks, including a proposal to limit enrichment to 3.5 percent. JNS/IAEA-linked reporting still confirms 60 percent enrichment as the technical risk floor. Diplomatic channel lowers the immediate device-risk move, but Iran-war coupling keeps dashboard risk higher. Probability 46%. Falling/critical.

iran_conventional.name: Iran War
iran_conventional.notes: May 10 evening scan: Washington Post reports US strikes on Iranian-flagged ships amid the Iran ceasefire; CBS/NBC report US destroyers under attack and US strikes on Iranian ports around the Strait of Hormuz. Britannica background describes deadly confrontations during US-flagged vessel transit. Hormuz remains restricted rather than confirmed closed. Probability 92%. Stable/imminent.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: May 10 evening scan: Al Jazeera reports Israeli air strikes in Lebanon killing 41 people in 24 hours and describes further violations of the declared ceasefire. Democracy Now and Peoples Dispatch also report lethal ceasefire violations. The cessation process exists but is being actively degraded. Probability 52%. Rising/imminent.

turkey.name: Turkey Nato
turkey.notes: May 10 evening scan: Stimson reports Turkey trying to mediate the US-Israel-Iran war and notes NATO interceptions of missiles heading to Turkey, underscoring spillover risk. SpecialEurasia highlights Turkey-Israel strategic rivalry. No verified Turkey-NATO kinetic escalation surfaced. Probability 10%. Stable/elevated.

india.name: India Pakistan
india.notes: May 10 evening scan: NYT/CBS report India and Pakistan agreed to a ceasefire after the worst fighting in decades, while CBS/WSLS report India accused Pakistan of repeated Kashmir breaches hours later. AP background confirms prior Indian missile strikes into Pakistani-controlled territory. De-escalation channel is real but fragile. Probability 36%. Falling/critical.

russia.name: Russia Nato
russia.notes: May 10 evening scan: PressTV, Al Mayadeen, TASS and United24 report Russian warnings over expanded NATO Baltic activity, Kaliningrad pressure, and claims NATO is rehearsing blockade or seizure scenarios. No Article 5 trigger surfaced, but rhetoric remains sharp. Probability 43%. Stable/critical.

china.name: China Taiwan
china.notes: May 10 evening scan: Army Recognition reports Taiwan civil-military drills to secure LNG and oil routes against a blockade scenario; AEI notes repeated PRC blockade rehearsals and Japan Times reports China joint drills in the East China Sea after MSDF transit. No invasion trigger surfaced. Probability 27%. Stable/critical.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: May 10 evening scan: Straits Times/BSS report Kim Jong Un ordered expanded missile production for 2026 and continued missile-development prioritization. Projectile risk remains active; no atomic-device event surfaced. Probability 18%. Stable/elevated.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: May 10 evening scan: KFGO reports Russia accusing Ukraine of drones and artillery during the ceasefire, TheJournal reports more than a thousand drone attacks, and Al Jazeera reports both sides traded fire despite the Victory Day ceasefire. The pause has little operational traction. Probability 84%. Stable/imminent.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: May 10 evening scan: Economic Times reports Pakistani strikes on Kandahar military facilities and a tunnel; Reuters background reports Pakistan-Afghan Taliban clashes alongside diplomatic efforts. Border-war risk remains critical but not newly expanding beyond prior scan. Probability 32%. Stable/critical.

sudan.name: Sudan Red Sea Spillover
sudan.notes: May 10 morning scan: RSF drone/infrastructure-strike reporting around Port Sudan/Khartoum and allegations of external backing remain active spillover concerns, but no new Red Sea maritime escalation or nuclear-power linkage surfaced. Probability 18%. Stable/elevated.
